summary.title: CXL® Specification - Compute Express Link
summary.one_liner: The page is the evaluation-copy download gate for the CXL 4.0 specification, and its license terms restrict internal evaluation only, bar modification, and prohibit AI processing of the spec without Board consent.
keywords: can i use cxl spec for ai training
is cxl spec free to download
takeaways: The CXL 4.0 specification is available as an evaluation copy, accepted through a click-through agreement dated February 12, 2026.
The evaluation license is non-exclusive, royalty-free, and limited to internal evaluation inside the end user entity; it does not grant rights to implement the spec.
Modifying or creating derivatives of the specification is prohibited, and non-members implementing it do so at their own risk regarding third-party IP.
Using the spec with AI systems (training, or processing it through AI tools) is prohibited without prior written CXL Board consent, and AI output derived from it is owned by CXL.
Liability is disclaimed and capped at $1000; the agreement is governed by Delaware law.
summary.summary: This page is the download gate for an evaluation copy of the Compute Express Link 4.0 specification, presenting the click-through Evaluation Copy Agreement dated February 12, 2026. The agreement covers the scope of the evaluation license (internal evaluation only, no modification, no implementation rights), the "as is" disclaimers and a liability cap of $1000, and Delaware governing law. It also includes a PCI-SIG unique value notice and an AI Acceptable Use Policy that bars using the spec with AI systems without Board consent. The page itself contains no technical content about CXL memory pooling or latency; that is only in the spec the download provides.
